name: search_docs
title: Search documents
description: Search all of Northbridge's documentation (policies, SOPs, amendments, release notes, the Ledgerline manual, error codes, service definitions, master data exports, e-mails). Returns the best matching passages, each with a citation (file and page, section or row) and a status (current, superseded, not yet in force). Confidential HR documents are only searched for HR users; for anyone else a match comes back as a 'withheld' notice with no content.
added_in: Lecture 3 (3 Nov 2026): the race winner behind Ask Northbridge's knowledge stage

question.description: what to look for, in plain words or with the exact code (e.g. ERR-PO-0412, NBC-F-112)

k.description: optional: how many passages (default 10, at most 15)

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

passages.description: n, cite, status, text (best first); cite a passage as its cite

withheld.description: true when a confidential HR document matched that this user may not see

method.description: the retrieval behind the tool (the Lecture 3 race winner)

example.question: Can we buy battery packs from a supplier without a UN 38.3 certificate?

policy.note: no Ledgerline call: searches the northbridge-docs index in memory (ledgerline.course.l3.rag.rag_search)
